top_signals.title: JPMorgan, Goldman Curb Exposure on $5 Billion Volta AI Loan Sale
top_signals.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. and Goldman Sachs Group Inc. have taken a rare move to limit their exposure on a $5 billion loan sale for AI startup Volta Infrastructure Holdings Ltd. as investors demand higher yields for risky debt tied to the artificial intelligence boom.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: French defense firm Thales to build Japan base, media report says
top_signals.summary: Thales Chairman and CEO Patrice Caine told the Nikkei daily that the base "will mark a milestone toward Thales's long-term engagement in Japan."
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
